meta.name: KAY Riviera — refined dashboard
meta.direction: Light ivory workspace, luminous coastal header, deeper warm charcoal sidebar, honey actions, and distinct categorical status colors.
meta.visualReference: Refinement of the user-selected Riviera dashboard
meta.precision: These are exact intended implementation tokens, not sampled or guaranteed pixel colors from the generated visual.
meta.revision: User correction: each chart status has its own distinct hue; sidebar darkened. Existing fonts, brand colors, layout and source counts are preserved.

format.name: kay-custom-design-tokens
format.status: Project-specific documented JSON format; not claimed to implement the W3C Design Tokens Community Group format.

tokenRecord.dimension: CSS dimension string with an explicit unit, including px or em.
tokenRecord.number: JSON number; used for font weights, variable axes and SVG stroke width.
tokenRecord.shadow: A complete CSS box-shadow string; compound lengths and color remain together.
tokenRecord.cssColor: A CSS color string that may contain alpha; not included in opaque sRGB contrast calculations.

references.syntax: A whole string containing a dot-delimited token path enclosed in braces.
references.scope: References resolve to a token value below tokens; recursive aliases are permitted, cycles are invalid.
references.cssExport: Join token path segments below tokens with hyphens; convert camelCase to kebab-case; resolve aliases before output.

stage.count: Nonnegative integer or null. null means unknown, never zero.
stage.legendValue: Em dash for null, otherwise the decimal integer as text.

contentSchema.demoDataset: Must declare illustrative=true and display the supplied demonstration label.

fill.description: Blue identifies September in the comparison chart; this period meaning is independent of pipeline stages.
Purple identifies October in the comparison chart; this period meaning is independent of pipeline stages.

drawerBackdrop.description: Existing translucent modal backdrop; excluded from opaque-pair contrast claims.

kpiWrap.description: Allow KPI groups to wrap below this viewport width.

panelStack.description: Stack both the pipeline and agent panel grids below this viewport width.

sidebarDrawer.description: Replace the persistent sidebar with an accessible dialog drawer below this viewport width.

compact.description: Compact mobile padding and wrapping below this viewport width.

offset.description: Gap between the control and keyboard focus outline.

panel.description: Existing restrained panel and KPI elevation; not a contrast boundary.

display.opticalSizing: Explicit opsz=40; CSS font-optical-sizing:none prevents automatic substitution.

fonts.delivery: Keep the bundled, version-pinned files at the relative paths above. Do not silently replace them with a live CSS font endpoint.
fonts.numerals: Use lining and tabular numerals for KPI values, chart values, counts, dates and monetary amounts.

sidebar.activeTreatment: Opaque olive-charcoal capsule; 32px gold square icon tile; charcoal 20px icon; white label; small gold trailing ChevronRight.
sidebar.selectedState: The gold tile and trailing chevron supplement the subtle active surface; do not rely on the surface change alone.
sidebar.landmark: Use a nav landmark with an accessible name and exactly one aria-current=page link.

hero.photo: Bright coastal architectural panorama with sunlit ivory buildings and clear sea.
hero.textProtection: Place text on the solid ivory hero-copy area; the photo may fill the remaining area. Any alternative text-on-photo composite requires a separate contrast review.
hero.headingLevel: Use one h1 for Tableau de bord.

kpi.alignment: Circular badge at left; label, value, and optional metadata form one right-hand column.
kpi.valueColorRule: Use each category foreground for both the icon and numeric value; the label stays charcoal. Each category foreground passes the declared 4.5:1 token contrast target on its card.
kpi.minimumHeightIsNotFixedHeight: Allow cards to grow when helper text or localized values wrap.

panel.separation: Surface and spacing define panels. No default card outline; reserve visible borders for controls, focus and necessary dividers.

input.labels: Keep a visible label; placeholder text does not replace it.
input.errorSemantics: Use aria-invalid=true and aria-describedby pointing to actionable error text.

disabled.behavior: Use native disabled where appropriate. If aria-disabled is used so a reason remains discoverable, JavaScript must suppress activation.

controls.loading: Keep the original button width and label. Add aria-busy=true and a decorative spinner; prevent duplicate submission without replacing useful context.

focus.behavior: Use :focus-visible. Do not remove the outline without a visible replacement.

controls.links: Use darker gold for small action text; underline on hover and focus. In prose, retain an underline by default.

icons.placement: Leading icon for actions and filters; trailing chevrons for disclosure or selected navigation; KPI badge uses its separate 12px gap.
icons.accessibility: Decorative SVG: aria-hidden=true and focusable=false. Icon-only buttons need a localized accessible name and a 44px target.
icons.strokeMeaning: Supported SVG shapes use vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke so strokeWidth=1.75 remains 1.75 CSS pixels on screen at the declared 20px, 18px and 16px icon sizes.

responsive.behavior: Wrap KPI groups while keeping Situation actuelle and Période sélectionnée attached to their own metrics.
Stack pipeline panels and stack agent chart panels. Chart legends may wrap.
Hide the persistent sidebar and expose a labeled menu button opening a native modal dialog drawer.
Use 16px page gutters; let filter controls and their labels wrap; stack hero media below the text when needed.

drawerBehavior.open: Call showModal(); connect aria-controls to the dialog ID; update the opener aria-expanded state.
drawerBehavior.name: Give the dialog an accessible name with aria-labelledby or aria-label.
drawerBehavior.focus: Focus a meaningful element such as the close button when opened; native modal behavior confines tab navigation; restore focus to the opener when closed.
drawerBehavior.close: Provide a visible labeled close button and preserve the native Escape close behavior.
drawerBehavior.background: Background content is inert while the native modal is open.
drawerBehavior.implementationBoundary: CSS supplies presentation only. The host application must implement opening, closing, focus restoration and state updates.

statusBadge.meaning: Action, warning, error and success badge semantics remain separate from categorical chart identity.

panels.purpose: Separation through spacing and restrained shadow.

dividers.purpose: Decorative grouping; not the sole control boundary.

currentSnapshot.label: Situation actuelle
currentSnapshot.scope: Current authorized agency/responsible-user record snapshot, independent of the date range.

selectedPeriod.label: Période sélectionnée
selectedPeriod.scope: Selected-period metrics; preserve existing product formulas and authorization rules.

items.label: Encaissements
items.definition: Valid receipts with existing corrections applied.

pipelines.interpretation: Current stage populations, not measured step-to-step conversion rates.
pipelines.segmentRule: Render a segment only when count is an integer greater than zero. Keep zero and unknown categories in the labeled legend.
pipelines.unknownRule: null displays as an em dash and never contributes a fabricated count or percentage.
pipelines.geometry: The staged funnel is a schematic ordering device; labeled counts are authoritative. Do not infer transition rates from the taper.

stages.label: À relancer
stages.semanticMeaning: Active prospect requiring follow-up; overdue is not implied.

stages.label: Qualifié
stages.semanticMeaning: Qualified active prospect; not a won deal.

stages.label: Non qualifié
stages.semanticMeaning: Not-qualified prospect. Orange is its categorical chart identity; it is not shown as a success.

stages.label: Indésirable
stages.semanticMeaning: Excluded or unwanted prospect; distinct pink categorical identity.

stages.label: Clôturé
stages.semanticMeaning: Closed outcome unspecified; slate categorical identity. Count was cropped in the source and must not be inferred.

stages.label: Documents
stages.semanticMeaning: Active documentation stage; not yet won.

stages.label: Annulée
stages.semanticMeaning: Cancelled deal; slate categorical identity, not a successful outcome.

pipelines.colorRule: Each of the nine prospect categories has a distinct hue. The eight deal categories reuse the fixed mapping for semantically equivalent or corresponding categories. Labels preserve exact status meaning.

left.title: Demandes par agent
left.subtitle: Comparaison mensuelle · exemple
left.meaning: Blue identifies September and purple identifies October. These series colors describe periods, not pipeline stages.
left.labels: Place numeric labels outside the bars in charcoal; preserve the visible period legend.
left.provenance: Fictional per-agent allocation. October total matches the supplied 12 requests; September comparison is illustrative.

right.title: Affaires par agent
right.subtitle: Situation actuelle · exemple
right.meaning: Each segment reuses the exact fill and label color from the deal-stage dictionary.
right.legendRule: Show all eight deal statuses, including zero counts, in a complete labeled legend. Use four columns and two rows when space permits; wrap to two columns on compact screens.
right.segmentRule: Do not draw zero-sized segments or assign them a minimum visible width.
right.labels: Show segment counts when space permits; otherwise provide a directly associated count list. Show the total above each stack.
right.provenance: Fictional ownership allocation; its stage totals reconcile to the supplied six current deals.
right.legendPlacement: Below the panel header, above the chart; do not force eight entries onto one row.

accessibilityNotes: Token contrast checks apply to opaque sRGB color pairs only and do not certify the raster mockup or the complete application.
Keep stage names and values visible. Distinct hues and 2px white gaps are not sufficient by themselves to communicate exact quantities.
Bright categorical fills, especially yellow and cyan, supplement visible stage names and counts; color alone is not the data representation.
Supply each chart with an accessible name, a concise description, and a table or equivalent list of its exact data.
Use real buttons and links, native form controls, ordered heading levels, and visible keyboard focus.
Do not encode selection, warnings, losses or success in color alone.
Use minmax(0, 1fr), flexible legends and wrapping labels. Do not hide horizontal overflow to conceal an inaccessible layout.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Charts do not require animation to communicate their values.

validation.method: WCAG relative luminance contrast formula, using exact opaque sRGB token colors.
validation.scope: Declared text and required control/state-indicator pairs only. Decorative surfaces, photos, separators and adjacent chart hues are not asserted to satisfy a contrast target.
validation.claimLimit: A token-level calculation is not a claim of complete WCAG conformance.
